name: inspira-scales
blurb: Repeating line pattern with customizable orientation and spacing.
description: CSS-based scales pattern using repeating linear gradients. Supports horizontal, vertical, or diagonal orientation with configurable line size and custom colour.
use_when: A lightweight static pattern background with flexible orientation and customisation.
avoid_when: Very fine line spacing on low-DPI displays may cause moiré patterns.
a11y: Background pattern with content slot rendering children above (z-10). Purely decorative pattern.
